# midasheng-gen-mcp - full LLM documentation

## What this server does

MiDashengLM-Gen MCP wraps the MiDashengLM-Gen model (Xiaomi Research,
arXiv 2608.11804, Apache-2.0): the first end-to-end trained general
text-to-audio model per the paper. An LLM backbone (Qwen3-1.7B, fully
fine-tuned) autoregressively drives per-token conditional flow matching
(16-layer DiT) to generate variable-length 16 kHz mono audio scenes that
blend speech, music, sound effects, and environmental acoustics from
structured text captions. Total model size 2.9B params (~12 GB fp32 VRAM).

Key capabilities from the paper: speech intelligibility approaching
dedicated TTS (Seed-TTS benchmark WER 12.15% -> 2.79% vs 1.24% for
dedicated TTS), competitive mixed-audio quality on MECAT, multilingual
support (9 languages), emotion control via the speech view.

The server is FastMCP 3.4.4 with dual transport: stdio for Claude Desktop,
streamable HTTP (/mcp) for Cursor and the webapp. REST surface for the
React dashboard. Everything runs locally on the user's GPU; the checkpoint
downloads from Hugging Face on first use.

## Architecture

- `src/midasheng_gen_mcp/` - Python package (FastMCP + FastAPI)
- `webapp/` - React 18 + Vite + Tailwind + Zustand dashboard
- `data/` - SQLite index (scenes, jobs) + generated WAV files (gitignored)
- Ports: backend 11159 (REST /api + MCP /mcp), frontend 11160

Data flow:
1. Caption views composed into a tagged prompt
   (<|caption|> <|asr|> <|speech|> <|sfx|> <|music|> <|env|>)
2. ModelManager lazily loads the checkpoint (idempotent) onto CUDA fp16
3. model.generate() runs 10-step Euler ODE flow matching with CFG 2.0
4. Audio saved as WAV; scene row + job row persisted to SQLite
5. Webapp polls the job, serves the audio via /api/audio/{id}

## Tool reference

### audio_scene (portmanteau)

Operations:
- status: model state machine (not_installed / model_missing / unloaded /
  loading / ready / error), device, CUDA, torch/transformers versions
- generate: synchronous generation. Params: caption (required), asr,
  speech, sfx, music, env, eval_cfg (2.0), stop_threshold (0.5),
  min_stop_step (5), seed. Returns scene dict with audio_url.
- list: paginated (limit 1-100, offset, has_more)
- get: single scene by id
- delete: requires confirm=True (removes WAV)
- export: copy scene WAV to a destination path
- samples: built-in example captions (comedy club, rainy cafe,
  thunderstorm, jazz lounge, news report, forest dawn)
- download_model: fetch checkpoint from Hugging Face (idempotent)
- load_model / unload_model: GPU memory management

### midasheng_help

Topics: overview, generate, prompt_format, model_state, examples.

### Prefab cards

- show_scene_status_card: model + library status
- show_scene_card: one scene's metadata

## Environment variables

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|----------|---------|---------|
| MIDASHENG_BACKEND_PORT | 11159 | Backend port |
| MIDASHENG_FRONTEND_PORT | 11160 | Frontend port |
| MIDASHENG_HF_MODEL_ID | mispeech/midashenglm-gen | Model repo |
| MIDASHENG_DEVICE | auto | auto/cuda/cpu |
| MIDASHENG_PRELOAD_MODEL | 0 | Load at startup |
| MIDASHENG_DEFAULT_CFG | 2.0 | Default guidance |
| MIDASHENG_DEFAULT_STOP_THRESHOLD | 0.5 | Default stop |
| MIDASHENG_DEFAULT_SEED | (none) | Default seed |
| MIDASHENG_DATA_DIR | ./data | Data directory |
| MIDASHENG_OLLAMA_URL | http://127.0.0.1:11434 | Chat proxy target |
| MIDASHENG_OLLAMA_MODEL | (auto) | Chat model |

## REST API

- GET /api/health, /api/v1/diagnostics
- GET /api/dashboard, /api/capabilities
- GET /api/tools, /api/skills, /api/skills/{name}, /api/samples
- GET /api/scenes (limit/offset), GET/DELETE /api/scenes/{id}
- POST /api/generate (job), GET /api/jobs, GET /api/jobs/{id}
- GET /api/audio/{scene_id} (WAV)
- POST /api/model/download | /load | /unload
- GET /api/logs, GET /api/llm/discover, POST /api/llm/chat
- MCP streamable HTTP: /mcp (FastMCP 3.4.4, lifespan propagated)

## Model state machine

- not_installed: run `uv sync --extra model` (torch + transformers)
- model_missing: checkpoint not downloaded; download_model or start.ps1
- unloaded: checkpoint present, not in GPU memory
- loading: load in progress (idempotent)
- ready: ready to generate
- error: load failed; check error_message, retry load_model

Tools never fake success: missing stack/checkpoint returns success=False
with recovery options.

## Troubleshooting

- not_installed -> uv sync --extra model
- model_missing -> download_model / just model-download / Settings button
- CUDA out of memory -> unload other models; 6 GB fp16 required
- Slow generation -> CPU inference is 10-50x slower than CUDA
- POST /mcp 500 -> FastMCP lifespan must be propagated (already fixed in
  this repo; see fastmcp 3.4-features.md)
- Chat page offline -> start Ollama; check Settings provider probe
